subject: Hidden Staircase Room
text: Smashing the stone block that rises out of the pit with the Megaton Hammer causes a stairwell to appear inside the pit.

evidence.quote: Smash the face with the Megaton Hammer, and a stairwell will appear inside the pit.

subject: Hidden Staircase Room door
text: Dropping a wooden box onto the blue switch at the bottom of the stairs unseals the door.

evidence.quote: Drop the wooden box onto the blue switch at the bottom of the stairs to unseal the door.  Go through the door.

subject: Fire Trap Room
text: Smashing the stone block in the corner of the chamber above the Fire Trap Room with the Megaton Hammer drops Link to the floor below and creates a booster to higher doors.

evidence.quote: Stand on the stone block in the corner and smash it with the Megaton Hammer to fall to the floor below.  The stone block has created a booster that lets you access doors in this room that were previously out of your reach.

subject: Fire Trap Room high ledge door
text: Smashing the rusted switch beside the sealed door on the higher ledge with the Megaton Hammer unseals the door.

evidence.quote: Smash the rusted switch with your Megaton Hammer to unseal the door.  Go through it.

subject: Block of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time transports the Block of Time across the room down to the floor.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time to transport it down to the floor.

subject: Goron cell
text: Smashing the rusty switch on the opposite ledge with the Megaton Hammer opens the Goron cell below.

evidence.quote: Jump across to the opposite ledge, and smash the rusty switch with the Megaton Hammer to open the cell below.

subject: Goron cell chest
text: A chest inside the Goron cell contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Drop down and speak with the Goron in the cell, then take the Key from the chest in his cell.

subject: Fire Trap Room stone block
text: Smashing the large stone block held by scaffolding with the Megaton Hammer allows Link to ride it all the way down.

evidence.quote: Jump out to the block, stand on top of it and smash the block with the Megaton Hammer.  Ride the block all the way down to it's destination far below.

subject: Entrance Hall east door
text: Smashing the pieces of the totem pole away with the Megaton Hammer on the east side of the Entrance Hall reveals a door.

evidence.quote: Use the Megaton Hammer to smash the pieces of the totem pole away (make sure to stand on the left or right side of the totem) to reveal a door.  Go through it.

subject: Room of Fiery Enemies door
text: Defeating all the Fire Keese and Fire Slugs in the room opens the sealed door on the other end.

evidence.quote: Kill any leftovers, and the sealed door on the other end of the room will open. Go through it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Defeating the Gold Skulltula in the Deja Vu Room yields a Gold Skulltula Token.

evidence.quote: Kill the Like-Like, then kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: A Flare Dancer mini-boss is fought in the Lower Flare Dancer Room, where the Biggoron Sword is effective and the Megaton Hammer attacks too slowly.

evidence.quote: Defeat another Flare Dancer here.  This one is identical to the last one. Remember to use the Biggoron Sword if you have it.  Don't bother with the Megaton Hammer; it attacks too slowly.

subject: Lower Flare Dancer Room chest
text: Defeating the Flare Dancer makes its flame pillar disappear and reveals a chest containing bombs.

evidence.quote: Once the Flare Dancer is dead, then his pillar of flames disappears, revealing a chest.  Open the chest to get some... bombs.

subject: Boss Key Prison Room chest
text: Smashing the rusted switch opens the cell containing a Goron and an ornate chest with the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Use the Megaton Hammer to smash the rusted switch, opening the double-sided cell.  Speak with the Goron, then open the ornate chest to find the Boss Key.

subject: Pillar Room Boss Key door
text: Using the knocked-down pillar allows Link to jump across to the Boss Key door in the Pillar Room.

evidence.quote: With the pillar from the Fire Trap room knocked down to this point, you can now jump across to the Boss Key door that you couldn't reach the last time you were here (not that it mattered, since you didn't have the key anyway).  Jump across to the door, and go through it.

subject: Volvagia
text: In phase 1, Volvagia emerges from one of nine pits marked by smoke and cinders and can be stunned with a Megaton Hammer jump attack before being damaged.

evidence.quote: In Volvagia's first phase, he appears randomly in one of the nine pits that dot the battlefield.  You'll know which pit he'll appear in, as a large amount of smoke and cinders will appear around the pit... Smash his head with the Megaton Hammer (use a Jump Attack with the Megaton Hammer for best results), and it will briefly stun Volvagia.

subject: Volvagia
text: When Volvagia flies around breathing fire in phase 2, Link can avoid damage by continuously running in a small circle near the center of the arena.

evidence.quote: In his second phase, Volvagia will emerge from one of the pits (again, you can tell which ones by the smoke and cinders that appear around the pit) and fly around the room, chasing you and trying to breath fire on you.  The easiest way to avoid damage in this phase is to just run continuously to the left or right in a small circle, preferably near the center of the battlefield.

subject: Volvagia
text: When Volvagia flies to the ceiling causing boulders to rain down, the attack can be avoided by running to the arena's edge and hanging off.

evidence.quote: The roof will begin to fall, raining the battlefield with boulders.  Easily the best way to avoid this form of attack is to just run to the edge of the battlefield and hang off the edge.

subject: Volvagia
text: Defeating Volvagia causes a Heart Container to appear.

evidence.quote: After Volvagia dies, then take the Heart Container that appears and enter the ring of light to meet the Sage of Fire, Darunia.

subject: Darunia
text: Entering the ring of light after defeating Volvagia allows Link to meet Darunia, the Sage of Fire, and obtain the Fire Medallion.

evidence.quote: After Volvagia dies, then take the Heart Container that appears and enter the ring of light to meet the Sage of Fire, Darunia.

subject: Shattered plank bridge
text: Link can cross the shattered plank bridge in Death Mountain Crater by using the Hookshot on the planks hanging off the cliff.

evidence.quote: Use the Hookshot to pull yourself over to the other side of the bridge (target the planks hanging off the cliff and climb up them like a ladder).

subject: Great Fairy Fountain entrance
text: Smashing the two rocks across the drawbridge with the Megaton Hammer opens the doorway to a Great Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: On the other side of the drawbridge, there are two rocks which can be seen covering the entrance to a doorway, which is only partially visible.  Use the Megaton Hammer to smash the rocks and enter the doorway (you may have to smash the rocks multiple times), which turns out to be a Great Fairy Fountain.

subject: Great Fairy of Bondage
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol inside the fountain summons the Great Fairy of Bondage to double Link's magic meter.

evidence.quote: Play Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the symbol, and the Great Fairy of Bondage will appear and double the size of your magic meter.

subject: Upper Death Mountain Crater path
text: Smashing the gray rock outside the Great Fairy's Fountain with the Megaton Hammer opens a path with a ladder leading to upper Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: As you come out of the Great Fairy's Fountain, you'll find yourself practically thrown right into another gray rock.  Smash it with the Megaton Hammer, and you'll open a path leading up to upper Death Mountain Crater.  Jump over to the ladder and climb to it's top.
